page.content:
Mountain capital and seat of Princess Celestia.

How Canterlot connects

  • Location: Equestria — Canterlot is the mountain capital of Equestria.
  • Character: Princess Celestia — Princess Celestia holds court in Canterlot.

What is Canterlot?

Canterlot is Equestria's white-tower capital, home of the royal sisters, the Grand Galloping Gala, and the school Twilight leaves when she moves to Ponyville.

Key threads lead to Equestria and Princess Celestia.
